intent: Identify relative strengths among every existing strategy, alongside unchanged rejection criteria; do not optimize parameters or claim Bybit perpetual profitability.
dimensions: maximize worst return after operating expenses over base/stress and 0/1/2 extra signal days
minimize worst daily close drawdown after accrued operating expenses over those six scenarios
method: Within each asset, repeatedly remove nondominated Pareto fronts. Display unchanged robust-pass flag independently. For review prioritize robust passes, then Pareto tier, then worst return / max(worst drawdown,1), then candidate ID. No weighted score tuned to outcomes. Keep all126 rows including negative results. Retain original train-only ranking separately.
drawdown_amount: For each scenario accrue its original total operating cost equally over its daily curve; calculate each peak-to-trough cash decline and percentage using that peak. Report cash amount at the maximum-percentage drawdown AND independent maximum cash drawdown, never percent times initial capital mislabeled as realized drawdown.
yearly_stability: Report mark-to-market changes in the net accrued-cost curve by calendar year, including partial2026; descriptive, no independence assumption.
promotion: Research shortlist only. Future Bybit USDT perpetual replay needs authentic venue prices, funding events, mark prices, contract filters and recorded depth. At most three distinct families shortlisted per asset; no automatic live or frozen-paper migration.
